event_description: Fired when a user views a product detail page — the top of the purchase conversion funnel.
Fired when a user clicks the Add to Cart button on the product detail page.
Fired when a user clicks Buy Now, immediately adding the product to cart and navigating to checkout.
Fired when a user adds a product to their wishlist from the product detail page.
Fired when a coupon code is successfully applied to the cart.
Fired when a gift card code is successfully applied to the cart.
Fired when the user initiates payment (clicks Place Order for COD or Go to Payment for card) on the checkout page.
Fired when the user submits the Stripe payment form to complete a card/UPI payment.
Fired on the client when a Stripe payment is confirmed and the order is created successfully.
Fired server-side when a COD or gift-card-covered order is successfully created in the database.
Fired when a user moves an item from their wishlist directly into the cart.
Fired server-side when a customer successfully submits a return request for an order.
Fired when a new user completes account registration, also triggers PostHog identify.
Fired when an existing user successfully logs in, also triggers PostHog identify.
Fired when a user logs out, also triggers posthog.reset() to clear the identified session.
